## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Acronym` | String | Well-known acronym for the exchange (e.g., 'CME', 'NYMEX', 'CBOT', 'COMEX'). | REST |
| `Id` | String | Numeric identifier for the futures exchange or trading venue. | REST |
| `Locale` | String | Geographic location code where the exchange operates. | REST |
| `Mic` | String | Market Identifier Code (MIC) - ISO 10383 standard four-character code for the futures market. | REST |
| `Name` | String | Full official name of the futures exchange (e.g., 'Chicago Mercantile Exchange', 'New York Mercantile Exchange'). | REST |
| `OperatingMic` | String | Operating Market Identifier Code for the futures exchange. | REST |
| `Type` | String | Type of venue - 'exchange' for futures exchanges and derivatives trading platforms. | REST |
| `Url` | String | Official website URL of the futures exchange organization. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
